pipeline.modality: Oral small molecule dual integrin inhibitor

indications.indication: Advanced or metastatic solid tumors resistant to immune checkpoint inhibitors (initial signals in cholangiocarcinoma, melanoma, HNSCC, NSCLC)
indications.trial_name: Phase 1 dose-escalation of PLN-101095 monotherapy followed by combination with pembrolizumab
indications.trial_design: Open-label dose-escalation; 14-day PLN-101095 monotherapy run-in then combination with pembrolizumab. 16 patients across 5 cohorts (250 mg BID to higher doses). Across 3 highest-dose cohorts: 4 responders (1 confirmed CR, 2 confirmed PR, 1 unconfirmed PR) of 10 secondary ICI-refractory patients; median time on treatment 15 months. Phase 1b indication-expansion in NSCLC and other tumors planned 2026.
key_milestones: Phase 1b indication-expansion initiation in 2026 (NSCLC and other tumor types)

excluded_legacy_terminated.reason: TERMINATED March 2025 following DSMB recommendation; development in IPF discontinued
